hook: Gig workers get *₹10 lakh* health cover under new Telangana scheme
hook_b: Gig workers get *₹10 lakh* health cover under new Telangana scheme
tldr: The Telangana Gig Workers' Social Security and Welfare Scheme was launched in Hyderabad on Saturday after a bike rally with gig workers.

beats.what: Rahul Gandhi and CM Revanth Reddy rode pillion with gig workers and launched the scheme under the gig workers act passed in March 2026.
beats.why: The scheme lets gig workers see data on their work, completed rides and earnings on their phones, which they could not access until now.
beats.care: The act also requires platforms to pay on time and ensure safe working conditions, and the state plans Wi-Fi-enabled rest zones.

causes.label: Gig workers act passed in March

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Rahul Gandhi said gig workers in India were not getting their own data until now, and the new law gives them that right.

qs: How will gig workers register to claim the insurance cover?

facts.t: The Telangana platform-based gig workers act was *passed in March 2026*; the welfare scheme is part of it.

viz.verdict: Gig workers gain health and accident cover under the act

viz.l: written notice before an app can terminate a worker

learn.t: Aggregator = the app company (food, cab, delivery) that connects gig workers to customers

watch: Where the first Wi-Fi-enabled rest zones for gig workers come up across the state.

sources.name: Hindustan Times
sources.title: Rahul Gandhi joins gig workers' bike rally in Hyderabad, launches welfare scheme

fact: Telangana's gig workers now get *₹10 lakh* health cover and *₹5 lakh* accident insurance
twist: Under the law, apps can fire a gig worker only for a valid reason, in writing, with *7 days'* notice.
